price.src: Provided by the user on 20-Nov-2026 (not an SEC-filed price). Reference points on EDGAR: average price paid for shares repurchased in the nine months to 30-Sep-2026 $125.12 (Q3-26 10-Q); $104.79 close on 21-May-2026 and $129.58 on 25-Feb-2026 (424B3).

guidance.text: Third-quarter 2026 release (4-Nov-2026): Q4 2026 guidance — revenue $1,365–1,415m, non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA $275–295m, non-GAAP EPS $2.45–2.80. 2026 non-GAAP framework — organic revenue growth mid-single digits, AMS/DRS organic growth mid-to-high teens, adjusted EBITDA margin expansion 30–50 bps, free cash flow conversion 40–45%. Full-year non-GAAP effective tax rate estimated at 27.2%. The guidance excludes NCR Atleos (closing expected early January 2027).

standalone_projections.note: Brink's Standalone Projections (management, early Feb-2026; joint proxy statement/prospectus 424B3 of 27-May-2026, "Certain Unaudited Prospective Financial Information"). Not guidance.

ncr_atleos.terms: Merger agreement 26-Feb-2026: each NCR Atleos (NYSE: NATL, CIK 1974138) share receives $30.00 in cash and 0.1574 Brink's shares (fixed exchange ratio). Shareholder approvals obtained (special meetings, June 2026); closing now expected in early January 2027, subject to regulatory approval (third-quarter 2026 release).
ncr_atleos.ppa_note: Preliminary purchase-price allocation, 424B3 unaudited pro forma (balance sheet at 31-Mar-2026): identifiable intangibles $2,895.4m (customer relationships $1,531.6m / 13 years, developed technology $1,252.9m / 8 years, trade name $110.9m / 5 years; new amortization $296.4m a year vs $95.0m historical), deferred tax liabilities $650.4m, debt assumed $2,866.0m (long-term $2,778.7m + current $87.3m), net assets acquired $199.3m, goodwill $3,333.1m at a $107.22 Brink's share price. Grouped here: other current assets = inventories $366.4m + prepaid and other $281.0m; other noncurrent assets = deferred tax assets $283.0m + other $391.2m; other current liabilities = accrued $581.7m + contract liabilities $434.8m + settlement liabilities $166.4m; other liabilities = deferred tax liabilities $650.4m + other $138.2m; retirement = pension $314.7m + other $3.8m.
ncr_atleos.financing: Pro forma financing (424B3): $2,276m drawn under the Base Bridge Facility (to be replaced by permanent debt) for the cash consideration and costs (debt costs ~$32m); NCR Atleos term loans and revolver ($1,468m at 31-Mar-2026) refinanced through the bridge, the delayed-draw term loan and the $600m revolver upsize; NCR Atleos senior secured notes stay outstanding. Pro forma incremental interest $90.7m (FY2025 basis): +$155m bridge, +$81m DDTL / revolver, −$143m NCR Atleos facilities repaid.
ncr_atleos.synergies: Deal release 26-Feb-2026: $200m of annual run-rate cost synergies (pre-tax) expected within three years of closing; at least 35% accretive to EPS (company basis); net leverage target 2.0–3.0x by the end of 2027; implied value $6.6bn = 7.2x 2026E NCR Atleos adjusted EBITDA.
ncr_atleos.proj_note: NCR Atleos February 2026 Standalone Projections (NCR Atleos management; 424B3). Adjusted EBITDA is before stock-based compensation. Not guidance; 2029E–2030E are internal extrapolations.
ncr_atleos.hist_note: NCR Atleos as reported (FY2025 revenue, operating profit, interest and net income from the 424B3 pro forma historical column; D&A, intangible amortization, stock-based compensation and capital expenditures from NCR Atleos XBRL company facts, rounded to $m). 9M-2026: operating income $423m, D&A $214m, net income $184m.

debt.at_2026_09_30: Debt at 30-Sep-2026 (Q3-26 10-Q): short-term borrowings $251.7m; term loans $1,218.9m; senior unsecured notes $1,392.4m; revolving credit facility $458.8m; other facilities $563.4m (incl. other revolving facilities $452m); financing leases $269.9m; total $4,155.1m. Amended and restated credit agreement of 31-Mar-2026: $1.225bn term loan and $1.0bn revolver, plus a delayed-draw term loan and a $600m revolver upsize available with the NCR Atleos closing.

buyback.text: Nine months to 30-Sep-2026: 241,321 shares repurchased for $30.2m (average $125.12); $720m remained under the 2025 Repurchase Program. 2025: 2,210,616 shares for $209.4m (average $94.74).

amort_sched.text: FY2025 10-K: estimated amortization of finite-lived intangibles recorded at 31-Dec-2025: 2026 $53.6m, 2027 $50.6m, 2028 $47.5m, 2029 $47.0m, 2030 $42.9m. Amortization of acquisition-related intangibles was $58.9m in 2025 and $43.3m in the first nine months of 2026 (releases).
